Name: Content Patcher - Conjoined Emily
Author: FightingPhlegm
Description:
Thanks to Darkgon for dialogue and content help! Conjoined Emily mod requires SMAPI and the Content Patcher.
No need to create a new save, the mod will work with existing save files.

All dialogue is altered to change Emily's pronouns to 'we' and 'us'. I wasn't able to change Emily's portrait name, so the twins are Emma and Lee and refer to themselves collectively as 'Emily' (thanks again to Darkgon for the idea!).

This mod does not interfere with any other mods as far as I know, unless content patcher is being used to replace Emily's sprites, portrait, or dialogue already.

The conjoined Emily is not visible to other players if you're playing multiplayer. Only those with the CJ Emily mod can see the conjoined sisters.
